Launcher bug found while creating the first hourly-tick schedule: batch_jobs.build_command hardcodes the schedule token 'hourly', which hf 1.30.0 advertises in --help but passes verbatim to the API, where it is rejected with 'Invalid CRON expression'. The API expects '@hourly' (see huggingface_hub/hf_api.py create_scheduled_job examples). Consequence: batch_jobs.py hourly-tick --execute cannot create a schedule in this environment. Fix is a one-token change in batch_jobs.py (auxiliary, not in code_hash), which per the release rules still requires a new release before publishing. No code was changed in this round; the schedule was created manually with the corrected token.

Operational hazard observed while replacing the schedule: 'hf jobs scheduled delete' in hf 1.30.0 accepts no --yes flag, so the first delete attempt failed silently in a pipeline and briefly left two @hourly schedules on the same run/output prefix. --no-concurrency only serializes within one schedule, so two schedules are exactly the cross-schedule conflict AGENTS.md warns about. The superseded schedule was deleted and only 6aaf18bb52d0dbd7f1d71571 remains. Before deleting a schedule, confirm the command actually succeeded instead of only checking the exit status of a pipeline.
